headline: Kalyan’s Q2FY27 revenue/EBITDA/PAT grew ~31%/30%/64% YoY. Gross margin contracted 61bps YoY to 12.3%, impacted by

highlights: Gross margin contracted 61bps YoY to 12.3%, impacted by a higher recycled gold mix (42% vs. 29% in Q2FY26), open-position losses in platinum/silver (-INR 83mn vs. +INR 212mn in Q2FY26), and a higher share of Franchise-Owned, Company-Operated (FOCO) revenues (~59% of India revenue).
This margin pressure was partly offset by ~INR 520mn in customs duty benefit.
Management maintains its focus on a leaner balance sheet, which was reflected in non-GML debt turning zero in Sep'26 (ahead of its FY27 target) and the company divesting non-core real estate assets.
We maintain a constructive view on Kalyan, driven by healthy SSSG, aggressive retail expansion, leaner balance sheet, ATM (as a material new growth driver), and strong H2FY27 growth expectations.
valuation: Management maintains its focus on a leaner balance sheet, which was reflected in non-GML debt turning zero in Sep'26 (ahead of its FY27 target) and the company divesting non-core real estate assets.
Valuation and risks We raise our EPS estimates for FY27/28E by 0.6%/3.1%, modelling revenue/EBITDA/Adj.
We reiterate BUY with a DCF-based revised target price of INR 800 (INR 700 earlier).
watch: Valuation and risks We raise our EPS estimates for FY27/28E by 0.6%/3.1%, modelling revenue/EBITDA/Adj.
Key risks include weaker discretionary demand, delays in FOCO store additions, and higher competitive intensity in core South Indian markets.
